audit_name: Benchmark Sampling, Privacy, Deduplication, and Quarantine Governance Architecture

strata_breakdown.rationale: Represents the core market volume and the primary production use case of ResumeMatch AI.
High toolchain specificity and complex transferable skill equivalencies (AWS/GCP/Azure/K8s).

strata_breakdown.stratum: Data Science / Machine Learning / Data Engineering
strata_breakdown.rationale: Evaluates nuanced technical depth, theoretical foundations vs engineering execution, and domain jargon.
Specialized testing frameworks (Selenium, Playwright, Cypress) with clear boundary verification.
Assesses non-code technical competencies, agile governance, and system-level requirement mapping.

reporting_methodology.unweighted_reporting: Raw empirical sample performance across all pairs (descriptive diagnostic).
reporting_methodology.post_stratification_weighting: Evaluates Macro F1 and accuracy re-weighted to match industry market hiring distributions (w_h = N_h / n_h).
reporting_methodology.cluster_aware_variance_estimation: Two-way crossed candidate-job clustered standard errors and GEE / cluster-bootstrapping for all reported confidence intervals.

deduplication_and_leakage_controls.near_duplicate_algorithm: MinHash LSH with 128 permutations, 5-gram shingles, Jaccard threshold = 0.85
deduplication_and_leakage_controls.exact_duplicate_algorithm: SHA-256 hash on normalized whitespace and lowercase text

cross_corpus_quarantine_verification.quarantine_rule: Any candidate or job description exhibiting >= 0.85 Jaccard similarity or identical normalized text with ANY historical training/val/test artifact is permanently disqualified from the Phase 12I benchmark.

pii_stripping_pipeline: Named Entity Recognition (NER) regex scrubbing for candidate full names, personal phone numbers, and personal email addresses.
Postal street addresses and zip codes redacted to generic metropolitan/state level.
Direct personal URLs (LinkedIn profile handles, personal portfolio sites) anonymized to synthetic placeholders.
Internal company proprietary project code names sanitized.

licensing_verification.recruitbench: Audited as research academic release; non-commercial evaluation permissible.
licensing_verification.djinni_cb: Verified Drushchak & Romanyshyn (2024), UNLP @ LREC-COLING 2024; research open access.
licensing_verification.final_benchmark_license: Strictly Internal Evaluation / Research Only (Not redistributed; held in secure evaluation vault).

quarantine_governance_rules.rule_1: Benchmark labels must be physically stored outside the training search paths (e.g. data/benchmark_vault/quarantine_phase12i/).
quarantine_governance_rules.rule_2: Zero access by feature extraction, vocabulary building, tokenizer training, or prompt engineering pipelines.
quarantine_governance_rules.rule_3: Evaluation scripts must run in one-way verification mode where model predictions are produced blindly on features, and scoring occurs in an isolated evaluation harness.
quarantine_governance_rules.rule_4: Quarantined official test labels (from Phase 12F) remain untouched and separate from Phase 12I benchmark.
